_about: Curated recommendations v1 (29 Oct 2026). Per country: SKU -> list of {sku, type: complement|substitute}. Order = priority. 'bundles' lists the component SKUs of a bundle sold as one Taager SKU; 'exclude_with' lists pairs that must never be shown together (size, voltage, duplicate function). A pair is added only when the two items are genuinely used together (complement) or answer the same need (substitute); never because of margin alone. No 'frequently bought together' claim until order data shows it. A rule that would sell her separately what one of the page's own offers sells cheaper as a bundle is never shown (the engine excludes it: the Iraq rack page already offers rack + mats for less).
